docs.summary: An [`IOrigamiIcon`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.IOrigamiIcon) that paints an SVG path through Quill's SVG parser/renderer. The path is parsed once, lazily, on first draw, then aspect-fit and centered within the target rect. This is the SVG counterpart to [`EditorGlyphIcon`](#api~Prowl.Editor.GUI.EditorGlyphIcon) (which paints a font glyph).
